package validators

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
)

func TestNodeValidatorRejectsEmptyWorkspace(t *testing.T) {
	validator := &NodeValidator{baseURL: "http://validator.local"}

	result, err := validator.ValidateAll(context.Background(), "task-1", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid result for empty workspace")
	}
	if len(result.Errors) == 0 || result.Errors[0].Code != "NO_SOURCE_FILES" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected errors: %#v", result.Errors)
	}
}

func TestNodeValidatorRejectsEmptySourceFile(t *testing.T) {
	validator := &NodeValidator{baseURL: "http://validator.local"}

	result, err := validator.ValidateAll(context.Background(), "task-1", []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "main.ts",
		Content: "   \n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid result for empty source")
	}
	if len(result.Errors) == 0 || result.Errors[0].Code != "EMPTY_SOURCE_FILE" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected errors: %#v", result.Errors)
	}
}
